themes.name: Agentic AI in research
themes.description: Focuses on AI agents that can autonomously perform research tasks, conduct experiments, and generate insights without constant human oversight.

themes.name: AI coding assistants
themes.description: Explores AI tools that help developers write, debug, and refactor code, accelerating the software development lifecycle.

themes.name: AI summarization
themes.description: Covers AI capabilities that condense large amounts of text, such as articles, reports, or user feedback, into concise summaries.

themes.name: AI research tools
themes.description: Highlights AI-powered platforms and software designed to assist researchers in various stages of their work, from data collection to analysis.

themes.name: AI sentiment feedback
themes.description: Focuses on AI's ability to analyze user reviews, social media posts, and other forms of feedback to gauge sentiment and identify trends.

themes.name: AI workforce impact
themes.description: Examines how AI is affecting jobs, skills, and the overall nature of work across different industries.

themes.name: AI usability testing
themes.description: Discusses AI applications in streamlining and enhancing the process of testing product usability and user experience.

themes.name: AI chatbot research
themes.description: Investigates the behavior, capabilities, and user interactions with AI-powered chatbots, including their impact on user well-being and trust.

themes.name: AI for design and research
themes.description: Covers AI tools and techniques that directly assist in the design process, from ideation and prototyping to generating design assets.

themes.name: Synthetic users
themes.description: Focuses on the creation and use of artificial user profiles or simulations for testing and research purposes.

note: Themes identified by analyzing articles from curated sources, Google News, HackerNews, and DEV.to this month.
